added: Release notes can include image galleries with captions and a larger keyboard-accessible viewer.
improved: Reduced unnecessary collision-index preparation during combat planning while preserving movement and combat behavior.
A zinc changelog timeline shows release history, with category icons and automatic desktop update availability on the main menu.
Reduced fog-of-war terrain calculations by retaining compact visibility footprints and skipping ray tests over proven-clear terrain. Visibility still updates at the same frequency.
Rebuilt the main menu with a dark woodland battlefield, carved charcoal controls, animated canopy light shafts and small fires, and a compact version label.
Units now handle nearby traffic with local detours and yielding instead of repeatedly recalculating routes across the map, reducing movement spikes in crowded matches.
Made menu light shafts brighter with drifting beams and dust, narrowed menu buttons, and enlarged and aligned fires with damaged buildings.
Shifted menu canopy rays away from the right trunk and added finer shafts through the left opening.
Extended menu fire smoke into taller drifting plumes and tripled the rising sparks.

added: Check for signed desktop updates from the main menu, with download progress and installation on restart.
Read the installed release's changelog directly from the main menu, even offline.
improved: Desktop releases and changelogs are delivered over HTTPS from dedicated release hosting.
fixed: Desktop builds find the standard Rust installation when Cargo is missing from the shell PATH.
Generated spell icons now use the game's supported size, preventing startup failures.
knownIssues: macOS builds are locally signed but not yet notarized by Apple.
